info.title: Nexwall Endpoint agent API
info.description: Served by the Controller to agents over TLS 1.3. The tenant and the device are read ONLY from the client certificate (URI SAN nexwall://tenant/<tenant>/device/<device>); a body or query that names a different identity is refused with 403. Preview: the contract may change before release.

servers.description: Replace with your Controller's agent address

post.summary: Exchange a single-use token and a CSR for a client certificate
post.description: Only the public key of the CSR is used. The tenant comes from the token and the device identifier is chosen by the Controller. Unknown, malformed, used, expired and deleted tokens all answer 401.

400.description: Invalid request or CSR (ECDSA P-256 or stronger required).

503.description: Pipeline, store or audit log unavailable. Retry later.

post.description: Same tenant and device only, and not before half of the certificate's lifetime has passed (409 before that).

get.summary: Fetch the signed policy document for this device
get.description: The revision is the ETag; an agent that already has it gets 304 without a body. 404 when the tenant has no policy yet, 503 when the store is unavailable (the agent keeps its last good policy).
